extract_features_from_videos: extract features from a list of video objects using a PyTorch model and config
perform_feature_extraction: perform end-to-end feature extraction on videos and save results as PyTorch tensors to disk
num_fvs: compute the number of video clips for a given video and inference config parameters
run_extraction: run the Hydra-configured feature extraction pipeline locally from the command line with a config file
review_TimeStats: review the TimeStats dataclass that tracks load, device transfer, and forward pass timing metrics
